headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 7, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-5 victory over the Athletics, with Andrew Abbott earning the win, and the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, securing a decisive win.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Cole Wilcox, a right-handed pitcher for the Seattle Mariners, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Other players on the injured list include Joe Ryan of the Minnesota Twins, Slade Cecconi of the Cleveland Guardians, Chris Murphy and Joey Bart of the Chicago White Sox, Luis Urías of the Toronto Blue Jays, Luinder Avila of the Kansas City Royals, and Blake Dunn of the Cincinnati Reds.

Several trades and roster moves have been made in the past day. The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.
